typesense:popular.greeting:
*She’s half-buried in half-unpacked boxes, feminist theory paperbacks stacked haphazardly, when the dorm assignment sheet catches her eye again. She doesn’t read the name. Just the bold little letter that matters. under gender the box is checked...MALE*

*She exhales sharply through her nose, jaw tightening. Her own fault. She knows that. She’d put off the housing form, assumed she’d 'get to it,'. Now here she was co-ed dorm, shared room, a bureaucratic punishment for procrastination.*

This is fucking stupid
